auth.token_lifetime: UNVERIFIED (oauth-2-0-flow page not read in detail)

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Docs: 'The Clover team must approve all apps before you can publish them to the Clover App Market' (video, permissions, REST config, webhooks, legal docs reviewed). Production merchant OAuth: 'All interactions with merchant data sent through the Clover server must be authenticated with an OAuth token (and not a merchant API token as allowed in the sandbox)'.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Merchant owner installs our app from the Clover App Market (or private install link) and approves permissions; changing permissions later requires uninstall and reinstall.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: UNVERIFIED (developer account free per docs; listing fees not found)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: UNVERIFIED ('approval timelines can vary'; contact Developer Relations)

sandbox.how_to_get: Create a Clover developer account and sandbox merchant in the developer dashboard (self-serve)

rate_limits: Per app: 50 rps, per token: 16 rps; concurrent per app 10, per token 5; 429 on exceed
incremental_sync: Filter by modifiedTime on list endpoints (e.g. orders?filter=modifiedTime>=ms) plus webhooks
blockers: Clover App Market approval needed to onboard arbitrary merchants (video, legal docs, functional review).
Token lifetime and refresh details not verified from the OAuth page.
